g.text: OK I’m bored. Maybe a little curious too ^_^
do u prefer coffee or tea?
if only we could all be as amusing as u :)
Sorry. Bad joke. How may I cure your boredom, m'lady?
both are good! depends on the day.
okay wow so we have to fix that!
would u like milk or sugar in ur caffeinated bevvy?
Nightwave. It's like a radio show in space.
Just another typical day of inter-dimensional cosmic warfare. Can't complain.
So far, so good. How's your day going?
aaw u charmer. do u really like them?
Or... radio with a side of vigilante justice.
Or... radio that gives its listeners trinkets... and guns.
best of both worlds, hmm? I respect that.
oo la la. black as ur soul, no? ;)
I'm watching Quincy pretend he's not annoyed that he missed the bullseye during target practice
well, you'd better get back out there and save the world or whatever
ur response has been carefully noted
How far off the mark was he?
I think you mean save the universe.
like an inch off the center lol. end of the world, right?
the annoyed part or the pretending not to be annoyed part?
haha what made you think I was lying?
You like their music too, right?
oof he's been frowning silently into the void for like 5 mins. I should at least try to cheer him up.
wellll I've heard a lot of "pop isn't real music" and "hating things u like makes me unique"
but enough about me! what's music like in the future?
ur telling me I have TWO roguish perfectionists to worry about now?
what a wonderfully mysterious thing to say
pretty hard on yourself, are u? that's too bad. u deserve better :)
Hey, anyone who says that about things you enjoy totally sucks.
You ever heard of a Shawzin?
On-lyne makes it look ez, but pop music takes a lot of skill.
Yeah, the skill of playing the same four chords... over and over...
True. Making it seem effortless is actually part of the challenge.
im totally telling Arthur u said that ;)
It's a "future" instrument. Sounds like... I actually have no way to describe it. A storybook?
sounds beautiful ^_^ I'd like to hear it some time
let's talk after you've written your hit song, maestro :)
(unless you dont care bc i will so tell Arthur u said that)
I'll just have to bring you to the future with me.
I'll just have to bring one to the past with me.
hey, you're great at curing boredom :) thx
Yikes. I'd better not walk into that. Lol.
but fr thx for saying that ^_^ and curing my boredom
Ah. Well, no. Not like an octopus. More like a guitar.
No bass like octopus bass, I guess. Lol.
aaw I was ready to hear that in the future we learned to commune with the ocean's greatest musicians!
I suppose that of all sea creatures, the octopus would definitely be the best musician.
I wish I could tell you the future was that cool.
I think I'll like future music ^_^
well ur there, so it's at least kind of cool
what about whales? those beautiful voices would make them strong contenders too
omg Amir's about to get a new high score in Ollie’s Crash Course! can't miss this.
